entries.zh: §S$ASTRAL_PLANES_TITLE$§!是一个内容丰富的剧情向拓展包，在其中可以探索其他的维度，或者随意揉捏现实的织构。
entries.en: §S$ASTRAL_PLANES_TITLE$§! is a rich narrative expansion allowing you to explore alternative dimensions and warp reality to your whim.

entries.zh: 我们推荐§SAstral Plane§!，它可以与§SOverlord§! DLC相匹配，进一步发掘超空间中继器和量子弹弓的灵活性。
entries.en: We are recommending §SAstral Planes§! as it pairs well with your §SOverlord§! DLC, allowing for further flexibility with Hyper Relays and Quantum Catapults.

entries.zh: 我们推荐§SAstral Plane§!，它可以针对§SAncient Relics§!中的先驱文明们带来新的探索机遇。
entries.en: We are recommending §SAstral Planes§! as it provides a new opportunity to explore the precursors found in §SAncient Relics§!.
This action can be used only once.

entries.zh: 该行动只能使用一次，能会为你的舰船增加新的功能。
entries.en: This action can be used only once, and then adds new functionality to your fleets.

entries.zh: 你必须完成§Y1§!个星界裂隙任务才能解锁该行动。
entries.en: You must complete §Y1§! Astral Rift to be able to unlock this action.

entries.zh: 你必须完成$NUM_RIFTS|Y$个星界裂隙任务才能解锁该行动。
entries.en: You must complete $NUM_RIFTS|Y$ Astral Rifts to be able to unlock this action.
$TRIGGER_FAIL$ §RThis action is on cooldown for $VALUE|Y$ days.§!
A new Astral Action is available.

entries.zh: 至少一个星界行动可用。
entries.en: At least one Astral Action is available.

entries.zh: 在我们舰船的引擎上装配$ASTRAL_THREADS_ICON$，提升其机动性能。
entries.en: Augment our ships' engines with $ASTRAL_THREADS_ICON$, improving their maneuverability.

entries.zh: 获得超空间中继器洞见
$ASTRAL_THREADS_ICON$的独特性质帮助我们更好地理解如何折叠空间。
entries.en: The unique properties of $ASTRAL_THREADS_ICON$ should help us better understand how to fold space on itself.

entries.zh: $ASTRAL_THREADS_ICON$的独特性质帮助我们更好地理解如何突破超光速旅行的界限。
entries.en: The unique properties of $ASTRAL_THREADS_ICON$ should allow us to further break the bounds of FTL travel.

entries.zh: 通过进一步驾驭$ASTRAL_THREADS_ICON$的能力，我们可以提升量子弹弓的精确度。
entries.en: By harnessing the capabilities of $ASTRAL_THREADS_ICON$ even further, we should be able to increase the precision of our Quantum Catapult.

entries.zh: 更深入利用$ASTRAL_THREADS_ICON$的力量，我们有望提升$sm_arkship_exodus_jump$的精准度。
entries.en: By harnessing the capabilities of $ASTRAL_THREADS_ICON$ even further, we should be able to increase the precision of our $sm_arkship_exodus_jump$.

entries.zh: 我们与星界位面的调谐加深了。现在可以召唤异次元体战士来支援我们的事业。至于他们从何、为何而来，目前尚不得而知。
entries.en: Our attunement to the astral planes has deepened. We are now able to call upon extradimensional warriors to support us in our cause. From where they come, or why they come, we cannot be sure.

entries.zh: 从一个未知的时空召唤一支强大的舰队。他们可以在我们的次元停留至多10年。
entries.en: Summon a powerful fleet from a place and time unknown. They can remain in our dimension for up to 10 years.

entries.zh: 我们召唤的异次元舰队已经返回了原本存在的位面。一丝痕迹都没有留下。
entries.en: The Dimensional Fleet we summoned has returned to its original plane of existence. No trace of it remains.

entries.zh: 通过将更多的$ASTRAL_THREADS_ICON$编织成空间的纤细织构，我们可以人为创造一处现实的裂隙。如果过于频繁尝试会导致星系陷入四分五裂的危险。
entries.en: By weaving extra $ASTRAL_THREADS_ICON$ into the delicate fabric of space, we should be able to create an artificial tear in reality. Doing this too often would put the galaxy in danger of unravelling entirely.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R我们没有可供进行裂分创造新的裂隙的恒星系。§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§RThere are no valid systems in which we can split open a new Rift.§!

entries.zh: 在随机一个你控制的恒星系内创造一道$ASTRAL_RIFT$。\n必须控制一个不与其他$ASTRAL_RIFTS$毗邻的恒星系。
entries.en: Creates an $ASTRAL_RIFT$ in a random system you control.\nMust control a system without any adjacent $ASTRAL_RIFTS$.

entries.zh: 随机在存在我方$waystation$的恒星系内产生一道$ASTRAL_RIFT$。\n必须拥有一座位于不毗邻$ASTRAL_RIFTS$的恒星系内的$waystation$。
entries.en: Creates an $ASTRAL_RIFT$ in a random system with an owned $waystation$.\nMust have a $waystation$ in a system without any adjacent $ASTRAL_RIFTS$.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R我们已经把自己强制打开全新时空裂隙的能力推到了极限。§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§RWe have pushed our capacity to forcefully open new rifts in space and time to its limit.§!

entries.zh: §R我们没有恒星系可供裂分创造新裂隙。§!
entries.en: §RThere are no valid systems in which we can split open a new Rift.§!

entries.zh: 允许科学家利用$ASTRAL_THREADS_ICON$以推进我们对物理学的理解。
entries.en: Allow our scientists to requisition $ASTRAL_THREADS_ICON$ to further our understanding of physics.

entries.zh: 我们可以操纵时间的流动来让我们可以同时使用两件强力的遗珍。
entries.en: We can manipulate the flow of time to make use of two powerful artifacts at once.

entries.zh: 可以在当前巡回展览的期限尚未截止时激活第二件遗珍。
entries.en: Allows you to activate a second relic without waiting for the current Triumph period to end.

entries.zh: 我们科学家确信，通过发现新的科技可以解锁额外的$ASTRAL_THREADS_ICON$行动。
entries.en: Our scientists are convinced that additional $ASTRAL_THREADS_ICON$ actions can be unlocked through the discovery of new technologies.

entries.zh: 解锁一项新的星界行动。
超空间航道本身具有有趣的量子性质，但通过将其与特定数量的星界丝交织，我们可以获得绝妙的结果。在突破其他的次元后，我们便可以取用现存（或未来将存在）的超空间中继器。几乎可以肯定，我们是唯一能行如此“借用”之事的人。
entries.en: Hyperlanes already possess interesting quantum properties, but by interweaving a given amount of astral thread, we achieved fantastic results. By breaking through to other dimensions, we can now access Hyper Relays that already exist (or will exist in the future.) We are nearly certain that we are the only ones 'borrowing' them in this manner.

entries.zh: 允许我们的工程船在一个星系中瞬间建造一座超空间中继器而不需任何花费。
entries.en: Allow our construction ships to instantly build one Hyper Relay in a system, at no cost.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R我们已经准备好基址让工程船建造了。§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§RWe have already prepared the site for our construction ship to do this.§!

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R我们的一艘工程船已经在前往进行该行动的路上了§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§ROne of our construction ships is on its way to do this§!

entries.zh: 对本次元及其他次元之间的织构进行巧妙地操控，我们可以使其自身折叠来实现一些其妙的效果。
entries.en: With some clever manipulation of the fabric between this dimension and another, we can fold it along itself to achieve some impressive results.

entries.zh: 解锁§Y舰队相移§!舰队行动，使舰队可以从现实相位中移出，在一个安全的维度停留§Y180§!天。\n\n舰队返航时将被完全维修。
entries.en: Unlocks the §YPhase Fleet§! fleet action, which allows your fleets to phase out of existence, safe in a different dimension for §Y180§! days.\n\nThe fleets return fully repaired.

entries.zh: 通过对维度之间的位面进行巧妙地操作，我们可以使空间自折叠来实现一些令人印象深刻的结果。
entries.en: With some clever manipulation of the plane between dimensions, we can fold space along itself to achieve some impressive results.

entries.zh: 解锁§Y星界跃迁§!舰队行动，使你的舰队可以瞬间跃迁至你边境内的任一星系。
entries.en: Unlocks the §YAstral Jump§! fleet action, which allows your ships to instantly jump to a system within your borders.

entries.zh: 解锁§Y星界跃迁§!舰队行动，使你的舰队可以瞬间跃迁至任一你已建造驿站的星系。
entries.en: Unlocks the §YAstral Jump§! fleet action, which allows your ships to instantly jump to a system you have a Waystation in.

entries.zh: 时空织构可以被某种方法拆解。建造一些精心校准的提取装置，我们可以稳定地产出一些$astral_threads$。
entries.en: There is a way to unravel the fabric between space and time. By constructing carefully calibrated extraction devices, we can produce a steady amount of $astral_threads$.
increases $ASTRAL_THREADS_ICON$ storage capacity and provides §Y[GetAstralResearcherJobWithIcon]§! Jobs.\n[GetAstralResearcherEffect]

entries.zh: 从现实的织构上剥离星界丝缕是一件精细活。这些结构保护着现实的边界不发生崩溃。
entries.en: It is a delicate process to peel Astral Thread away from the fabric of reality. These structures prevent the border between realities from crumbling.

entries.zh: 前往星界位面的旅程让我们对维系宇宙的织构有了更深的了解。这些丝线几乎没有其他人能理解，我们却能以其尽情编织。
entries.en: Our journeys into the Astral Planes have helped us better understand the fabric that binds the universes. We can weave these threads in ways few others comprehend.

entries.zh: 我们已经学会了将星界丝缕编织成这个宇宙中的任何其他物质。这正是维度本身的织构。
entries.en: We have learned how to weave Astral Thread into any other material in the universe. It is the very fabric of dimension.

entries.zh: 其他所有材料资源获取提升§Y10%§!。
entries.en: Increase all other material resource gains by §Y10%§!.

entries.zh: 没有什么壁垒比密织的星界丝缕阵列更加坚固。
entries.en: There is no stronger barrier than a tightly knit lattice of Astral Threads.

entries.zh: 将一件具有重要文化意义的物品通过其他维度进行展示，在特定的条件下是可行的。但这一行为会不会在其他位面被注意到我们不得而知。
entries.en: Manifesting objects of cultural significance from other dimensions can be done under the right circumstances. Whether or not our actions will be noticed in the other planes, we cannot say.

entries.zh: 每完成一个§Y星界裂隙§!：\n$t$解锁额外的§Y星界行动§!。\n$t$§Y$ASTRAL_THREADS_ICON$§!储存上限：§G+$@astral_threads_capacity_from_each_explored_rift|*0$§!。
entries.en: For each §YAstral Rift§! completed:\n$t$Unlock additional §YAstral Actions§!.\n$t$§Y$ASTRAL_THREADS_ICON$§! storage capacity: §G+$@astral_threads_capacity_from_each_explored_rift|*0$§!.

entries.zh: 与星界位面的调谐越深入，就有越多的可能性被解锁。
entries.en: A deeper attunement to the Astral Planes unlocks further possibility.

entries.zh: £astral_threads£$astral_threads$是一种时空浓缩而来的细丝，是不同维度位面互相碰撞的产物。可以用来产生各种全国范围的效果。
entries.en: £astral_threads£ $astral_threads$ are filaments of condensed space-time: the result of dimensional planes colliding with one another. They can be spent to enact various empire-wide effects.

entries.zh: 在对§Y[From.GetStarName]§!进行调查时，[Root.GetName]发现了一种新的战略资源，称为§H$astral_threads$§!。它在扭曲时空方面的独特性质可以用在若干有趣的用途。
entries.en: During its survey of §Y[From.GetStarName]§!, the [Root.GetName] discovered a previously unknown strategic resource dubbed §H$astral_threads$§!. Its unique properties in distorting time and space could be put to use in a number of interesting ways.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]在[FromFrom.GetName]发现了一种新的战略资源，称为§H$astral_threads$§!。它独特的扭曲时空的性质可以用于诸多有趣的应用。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] has discovered a previously unknown strategic resource on [FromFrom.GetName], dubbed §H$astral_threads$§!. Its unique properties in distorting time and space could be put to use in a number of interesting ways.

entries.zh: 让我们的科研船可以探索星界裂隙。
entries.en: Allows our science ships to explore Astral Rifts.

entries.zh: 以各种方式利用$ASTRAL_THREADS_ICON$为我们服务。
entries.en: Utilize $ASTRAL_THREADS_ICON$ in various ways to our benefit.

entries.zh: [From.solar_system.GetName]星系的细缝发生了失稳，打开了一道通往其他时空的裂隙。\n\n我们应当小心应对。
entries.en: The dimensional scar in the [From.solar_system.GetName] system has destabilized, opening a rift into another place and time.\n\nWe should approach with caution.

entries.zh: 我们在[from.solar_system.GetName]星系发现了一处特别的时空裂隙。也许我们花时间研究一些其特质就可以找到进一步探索的方式。
entries.en: We have discovered an extraordinary rift in space and time in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system. Perhaps if we take time to study its properties we can find a way to explore further.

entries.zh: 我们的人终于抵近到触手可及天空中裂缝的地方了。\n\n也许花点时间研究其性质便可以找到进一步探索的方法。我们完全无从得知在它里面到底有什么。
entries.en: Our people have finally reached far enough to touch the scar in our skies.\n\nPerhaps if we take time to study its properties, we can find a way to explore further. We have no way of knowing what may be on the other side.

entries.zh: 我们已经达成了先祖不曾触及之事。
entries.en: We have done what our ancestors could not.

entries.zh: 我们已经揭开了关于如何收集储存这种构成我们宇宙边界的星界物质形成的缥缈丝线的秘密。\n\n这种珍贵稀有的资源可以以诸多方式使用，使我们大受裨益。
entries.en: We have unlocked the secrets behind gathering and containing the volatile threads of astral material that make up the very border of this universe.\n\nThis valuable and rare resource can be applied in various ways that will benefit us greatly.

entries.zh: 我们失去了对[FromFrom.GetName]星系的控制，一并也失去了其中所含的时空裂隙。\n\n我们进一步探索的努力只能暂时告一段落了。
entries.en: We have lost control of the [FromFrom.GetName] system, and the rift in space and time contained within.\n\nOur efforts to reach beyond have been abandoned for now.

entries.zh: \n这一应对方案将会极大地加速我们的研究。
entries.en: \nThis Approach will greatly accelerate our research.

entries.zh: 我们发现了一处令人惊奇的时空裂隙。如果花时间研究其性质，我们或许能找到进一步探索的方式。我们无从得知里面究竟有什么。
entries.en: We have discovered an extraordinary rift in space and time. Perhaps if we take time to study its properties, we can find a way to explore further. We have no way of knowing what may be on the other side.

entries.zh: 我们的人终于抵近到触手可及天空中裂缝的地方了。\n\n也许花点时间研究其性质便可以找到进一步探索的方法。我们完全无从得知在它里面到底有什么。
entries.en: Our people have finally reached far enough to touch the scar in our skies.\n\nPerhaps if we take time to study its properties, we can find a way to explore further. We have no way of knowing what may be on the other side.

entries.zh: 我们当前的情况还不允许花费如此宝贵的资源。在远处观测这一现象即可。
entries.en: We are not in a position to spend such valuable resources. Let us observe this phenomenon from afar.

entries.zh: 可以让我们的科学家们分配大量的研究资源以揭开这一时空裂隙的秘密。
entries.en: We can dedicate a significant amount of research from our scientists towards unlocking the secrets of this rift in space and time.

entries.zh: 往裂隙中发送的每一个探测器都能加深我们对如何穿透其边界的理解。我们可以分配合金总产出的一部分用于此项目。
entries.en: Each probe we send into the rift furthers our understanding of how to penetrate its borders. We are able to dedicate a certain amount of our total Alloy production for this purpose.

entries.zh: 在研究§Y[target.solar_system.GetName]§!中的星界裂隙时，我们不可避免地扰动了这个维度异常，造成了严重的时空扭曲，让附近的现实以不可预知的方式发生了歪斜。
entries.en: While studying the Astral Rift in §Y[target.solar_system.GetName]§!, we have inadvertently destabilized the dimensional anomaly. This is causing violent distortions in space and time, bending nearby reality in an unpredictable manner.

entries.zh:
$astral_rift_discovery_event_text$

一颗我们称为§Y[planet_rift_in_space.GetName]§!的神秘行星突然无中生有般出现。我们任何一张星图中都没有其此前存在的记载。

其上承载着一个[GetPreFTLLower]文明。

我们只能推测它是通过某种方式来自我们宇宙之外的地方。
entries.en:
$astral_rift_discovery_event_text$

A mysterious planet, which we are calling §Y[planet_rift_in_space.GetName]§!, has appeared where before there was nothing. We have no records of its previous existence on any of our star charts.

It is populated by a [GetPreFTLLower] civilization.

Our best guess is that it somehow arrived from outside of our universe.

entries.zh:
$astral_rift_discovery_event_text$

在§Y[rift_temporary_species_planet.GetName]§!凭空出现了一个感性物种，均匀地与我们现存的人口混居着。

[rift_temporary_species.GetName]并没有关于他们来自何方的记忆，且没有表现出任何敌意。

无论他们来自哪里，看来我们都没有办法帮他们回家了。
entries.en:
$astral_rift_discovery_event_text$

A new sentient species has materialized on §Y[rift_temporary_species_planet.GetName]§!, distributed evenly across our existing population.

The [rift_temporary_species.GetName] have no memory of where they are from and do not appear hostile.

Wherever they originated, it is unlikely we can help them return.

entries.zh: $astral_rift_discovery_event_text$\n\n§Y[rift_temporary_planet.GetName]§!上严重的扭曲导致时间以两倍速流逝。我们需要密切关注这一局势，确保翻倍供应补给。
entries.en: $astral_rift_discovery_event_text$\n\nSignificant temporal distortions on §Y[rift_temporary_planet.GetName]§! are causing time to pass twice as quickly. We should monitor the situation closely, and make sure to double their supplies.

entries.zh: 这颗行星上的时间流逝速度翻倍了。
entries.en: Time passes twice as quickly on this world.

entries.zh: 我们发现，想要钻进时空的折缝中需要完美光滑的船体。\n\n只要分配足够的研究资源和时间，我们确信自己能研发这种装置，并可以暂时将其命名为“§Y$tech_rift_sphere$§!”。然后我们就有可能发现这个空间异常背后的秘密。
entries.en: We have discovered that slipping through the folds in space and time requires a perfectly smooth vessel.\n\nWe are certain that we can develop such a device, what we are tentatively calling a "§Y$tech_rift_sphere$§!", should we devote enough research and time. We may then finally discover what is beyond this spatial anomaly.

entries.zh:
我们已经开发出了这种能在星界裂隙的折缝中穿行的科技：§Y$tech_rift_sphere_plural$§!。

这种球体以高度先进、绝对光滑的纳米材料建成，可以在时空的乱流处无摩擦地滑行。

因为不知道所到地方的情况，每一艘§Y$tech_rift_sphere$§!都会连接上一条锚定缆线。缆线连接在我们宇宙中的一艘科研船上，以便在发生意外时将我们拉回。
entries.en:
We have developed technology that will allow us to slip between the folds of an Astral Rift: §Y$tech_rift_sphere_plural$§!.

Constructed of a highly advanced, perfectly smooth nano-material, the Sphere is able to frictionlessly glide through turbulent areas of space and time.

As we are unsure where we will arrive, each §Y$tech_rift_sphere$§! is connected to an anchor cable. To pull us back in case of emergency, the cable is tethered to a Science Ship in our universe.

entries.zh: 那就看看能找到什么吧……
entries.en: Let's see what we can find...

entries.zh: 该恒星系包含有至少一处星界裂隙
entries.en: This system contains at least one Astral Rift

entries.zh: 该恒星系包含有一个独特而奇异的§Y晶体裂隙§!。
entries.en: This system contains a unique and anomalous §YCrystal Rift§!.

entries.zh: 似乎时空倾向于汇聚成一层层互相叠盖的位面。在折缝中滑行的技巧则是关键。
entries.en: It seems that space and time tend to gather together in layers, all laid on top of one another. The trick is how to slip between the folds.

entries.zh: 收集从时空裂隙的边缘上剥离的星界纤维让我们可以精妙地改进我们的研究站。
entries.en: The harvesting of torn astral fabric along the scars of rifts in space and time is made possible with delicate modifications to our research stations.

entries.zh: 我们缺少必要科技\n无法探索该异常现象。
entries.en: We lack the technology necessary\nto explore this anomaly.

entries.zh: 我们缺少必要科技无法探索该异常现象。
entries.en: We lack the technology necessary to explore this anomaly.

entries.zh: 已经完成了一个星界裂隙的探索
entries.en: An Astral Rift has been fully explored

entries.zh: 这是一处不规则的折叠时空。其边界上正在泄露奇异物质，但我们无法进一步进入。
entries.en: This is an anomalous fold in space and time. Strange material leaks from its edges, but we cannot penetrate any further.

entries.zh: 我们发现了一道星界细缝。
entries.en: We have discovered an Astral Scar.

entries.zh: 一处新的星界裂隙已经可以进行探索了。
entries.en: A new Astral Rift is ready for exploration.

entries.zh: 我们的科研船锚定到了一道星界裂隙上。在探索完成之前，舰船和船员将不可另派任务。
entries.en: Our science ship is tethered to an Astral Rift. Ship and crew will be unavailable until exploration is complete.

entries.zh: 你的舰队已相位移动离开我们的存在位面。若能顺利返航，归来时大概会继续执行此前的任务。
entries.en: Your fleet has Phased from this plane of existence. If (and when) it returns, it will most likely do so at its previous position.

entries.zh: 有星界裂隙事件待决定
我们当前正在探索的一处星界裂隙出了些事情。
entries.en: Something has happened in one of the Astral Rifts that we are currently exploring.

entries.zh: 星界裂隙的每一阶段的探索难度水平可能存在差异。\n$RIFT_DIFFICULTY_EASY$阶段的难度为0-2，$RIFT_DIFFICULTY_NORMAL$为3-5，而$RIFT_DIFFICULTY_HARD$为6以上。难度越高，探索时段结束时成功结果的出现概率就越低。
entries.en: Each chapter in an Astral Rift can have a different difficulty value.\n$RIFT_DIFFICULTY_EASY$ chapters are 0-2, $RIFT_DIFFICULTY_NORMAL$ 3-5, and $RIFT_DIFFICULTY_HARD$ 6+. Higher difficulty may reduce the likelihood of a successful result at the end of an exploration phase.

entries.zh: 技能加成将增加探索时段结束时获得成功结果的可能性。\n\n这一加成会提升§Y突破几率§!。
entries.en: The skill bonus will increase the likelihood of getting successful results at the end of an exploration phase.\n\nThis bonus increases §YBreakthrough Chance§!.

entries.zh:
§H探索时段§!
星界裂隙的探索将会按时段进行，在每个时段结束会掷一次进度骰子。

下一个时段将会在£time£$DAYS|Y$后结束
entries.en:
§HExploration Phase§!
Astral Rifts are explored in phases, at the end of each phase a progress roll is made.

Next phase ends in £time£ $DAYS|Y$

entries.zh: §H前往§!\n§G点击以将视角快速移动至该裂隙所在位置§!
entries.en: §HGo To§!\n§GClick to quickly navigate the camera to where this rift is located§!

entries.zh: 线索代表你在星界裂隙探索的某一阶段中已掌握的信息量。\n\n拥有线索会提升§Y突破几率§!。
entries.en: Clues represent information uncovered during each stage of the Astral Rift exploration.\n\nClues increase §YBreakthrough Chance§!.

entries.zh: §H$ASTRAL_RIFT_EXPLORATION_LOG$§!\n$ASTRAL_RIFT_EXPLORATION_LOG$展示上一个调查时段的结果。
entries.en: §H$ASTRAL_RIFT_EXPLORATION_LOG$§!\nThe $ASTRAL_RIFT_EXPLORATION_LOG$ shows you the results of the last exploration phase.

entries.zh:
§H探索时段结果§!
已收集线索：$GAINED|Y$

结果：$RESULT|Y$
  投掷点数：$ROLL|Y$
  线索数：$CLUES|Y$
  技能加成：$BONUS|Y$

§R失败§!：结果值小于或等于§Y4§!，添加§Y0§!点线索。

entries.en:
§HPhase Results§!
Clues Gained: $GAINED|Y$

Result: $RESULT|Y$
  Roll: $ROLL|Y$
  Clues: $CLUES|Y$
  Skill Bonus: $BONUS|Y$

§ERoll Outcomes:§!
§RFailure§!: Results §Y4§! or less add §Y0§! clues.
§YProgress§!: Results between §Y5-9§! add §Y1§! clues.
§GProgress§!: Results between §Y10-13§! add §Y2§! clues.

entries.zh:
§H$ASTRAL_RIFT_BREAKTHROUGH$§!
此数值反映你的科学官在探索当前裂隙时取得突破的几率。

每当一个探索时段结束，游戏将自动掷出一枚骰子（结果范围为§Y1§!到§Y10§!）。掷骰结果会与§Y技能加成§!和§Y线索§!数相加，随后减去§Y难度§!值。

掷骰前的结果是$SCORE|0Y$。

§E最终结果：§!
entries.en:
§H$ASTRAL_RIFT_BREAKTHROUGH$§!
This reflects the chance of your Scientist making a breakthrough during exploration of the current rift.

Every time a phase ends, a die (§Y1§! to §Y10§!) is rolled. The result of the roll is added to §YSkill Bonus§! and §YClues§!, then subtracted by §YDifficulty§!.

The current score before dice roll is $SCORE|0Y$.

§ERoll Outcomes:§!

entries.en: A tear in time and space. We do not yet know what lies on the other side.

entries.zh: 一处异常的时空裂口。可以看到裂隙里漂浮着怪异的晶体。
entries.en: An anomalous tear in time and space. Strange crystals can be seen floating inside the rift.

entries.zh: 为战争而设计的超凡生物，这些全副武装的幼雏能够瞬间越过一小段空间，执行的包抄和伏击机动让敌人瞠目结舌。
entries.en: Otherworldly creatures engineered for war, these armored hatchlings are able to instantly traverse small distances, allowing the execution of impressive flanking and ambush maneuvers.

entries.zh: 这些小队为燃烧战而设计，往往造成相当大的连带伤害。
entries.en: Geared for incendiary warfare, these squads tend to inflict considerable amounts of collateral damage.

entries.zh: [fromfrom.leader.GetName]从一趟寻找因终末而消失的星系的$ASTRAL_RIFT$探险中返回了。他熟悉的许多地方已经完全从本现实中消失了。\n\n他还不确定自己回到的是不是正确的维度，显然是受到了一定的认知冲击。
entries.en: [fromfrom.leader.GetName] returned from exploring an $ASTRAL_RIFT$ to find a galaxy lost to the End. Many of the places they knew have vanished completely from this existence.\n\nThey are still uncertain if they returned to the correct dimension at all, and appear to be experiencing a form of cognitive shock as a result.

entries.zh: 通过将我们的舰船与一处空间折叠调谐至完全一致的量子特征，我们便可以使它的频率与我们平行。然而，这样的调谐不是永久的。这种缺口将会逐渐落回其自然的趋势。
entries.en: By attuning our ships to the unique quantum signatures of a fold in space, we can align its frequencies with our own. However, such an attunement is not permanent. Eventually, the breach will gravitate back toward its natural inclination.

entries.en: This leader has crossed the astral planes; the effects of such a journey are both lasting and profound.

entries.zh: 这位领袖不幸遭遇了一只来自异次元的巨型蠕虫。尽管躯体已经不再完整，但他对分子生物学产生了独到的见解。
entries.en: This leader has had an unfortunate encounter with a giant worm from another dimension. While no longer whole of body, they have gained some unique insight into molecular Biology.

entries.zh: 这位领袖专业研究星界裂隙以及其他维度的行为。
entries.en: This leader specializes in the study of Astral Rifts and the behavior of dimensions outside of our own.

entries.zh: 与空间之间的间隙深度同调，这位领袖能够轻易在星系之间滑移。
entries.en: Deeply attuned to the spaces between space, this leader is capable of slipping easily across galaxies.

entries.zh: 恰当地校准能量武器所需要的计算能力和精准聚焦要花费无数的时间学习，但对这位指挥官来说就像与生俱来一般。
entries.en: The calculations and precise focusing it takes to properly calibrate energy weapons can be incredibly time consuming, but such skills come naturally to this commander.

entries.zh: 该物种的外膜和无定型躯体使其可以轻易适应任何环境，并且完全免疫各种疾病。
entries.en: The external membrane and amorphous body of this species allows them to adapt to any environment and renders them immune to a wide variety of diseases.

entries.zh: 这个物种起源于另一个维度，需要大量能量才能在我们的宇宙中生存。
entries.en: This species originates from another dimension and requires a great deal of energy to survive in our universe.

entries.zh: 一道巨大的时空裂隙高悬于该文明母星的穹顶。在研究这一现象近千年后，最近的星舰科技进展使其终于可以靠近他，并且发掘潜藏其中的秘密。
entries.en: A massive rift in space and time looms near this civilization's homeworld. After studying the phenomenon for millennia, recent advances in starship technology will allow them to finally reach out and discover what secrets it might hold.

entries.zh: 自我们有记忆起，大裂隙就在[GetHomeWorldName]的天空中高悬着。传说我们的遥远过去与这道天界之痕还有我们首都附近的天降之坑相互纠缠。\n\n我们祖祖辈辈都将这个撞击坑视为圣地，却对其知之甚少。然而，最近的地震活动却让坑下的一处异常现象重见天日。我们正在着手向其核心钻探。至于在坑里到底会有什么发现，人们莫衷一是。$START_SCREEN_RIFTWORLD_END$
entries.en: For as long as we can remember, the Great Rift has loomed in the skies above [GetHomeWorldName]. Legends propose that our past is intimately entwined with this mysterious celestial scar and an ancient impact site near our capital.\n\nFor generations, the site was revered, but little understood. However, recent seismic activity has uncovered subsurface anomalies in the crater. Preparations are already underway to drill into its core. Opinions remain divided on what we may uncover there.$START_SCREEN_RIFTWORLD_END$

entries.zh: 穷尽我们数据库所能追溯的最早时间，大裂隙就早已高悬于[GetHomeWorldName]的上空。我们的内部时钟于该裂隙天体的频率相同步，而最早的记录则记录了一处位于我们首都附近的远古撞击坑。\n\n无数次迭代以来，该撞击坑都被保留下来，但却对其几乎没有任何了解。然而，最近的地震活动却让坑下的一处异常现象重见天日。我们正在准备向其核心钻探。$START_SCREEN_RIFTWORLD_END$
entries.en: For as long as our databanks reach back, the Great Rift has loomed in the skies above [GetHomeWorldName]. Our internal clocks are synced with the frequency of the celestial scar and our earliest records describe an ancient impact site near our capital.\n\nFor many iterations, the site was left alone, but little understood. However, recent seismic activity has uncovered subsurface anomalies in the crater. Preparations are already underway to drill into its core.$START_SCREEN_RIFTWORLD_END$

entries.zh: \n\n这难道只是一个发生在我们超空间引擎科技取得进展时的普通巧合吗？就在我们直抵天界时，我们的注意力被重新拉回了地面上。也许在这颗星球的地下潜藏着的是对于我们前往星间旅行的启迪，也许它可以让我们做好应对裂隙另一端的事物的准备。
entries.en: \n\nIs it simple coincidence that this has occurred at the advent of Hyperdrive technology? Just as we reach for the heavens, our attention is pulled back to the ground. Perhaps what lies beneath the surface of this world is meant to aid us on our journey to the stars. Perhaps it can prepare us for whatever lies beyond the Rift.

entries.zh:
自我们有记忆起，大裂隙就在虚空中高悬着——它就这样一直横亘在我们旅途的地平线之上，我们无法解释，却又无比熟悉。传说我们的遥远过去与这道天界之痕，以及深藏于我们方舟船体内部的某个远古撞击点有着千丝万缕的关系。

多年以来，这个地方俨然成为圣地，却鲜有人能真正了解。然而，最近方舟核心系统出现的波动，将人们的注意力引向了撞击点附近那些长期封闭的舱室。我们正准备突破这些舱室。至于我们会在那里发现什么，大家众说纷纭。

系统波动恰好发生在超光速引擎技术问世之际，这会是单纯的巧合吗？正当我们要伸手触碰星辰之时，注意力却被拉回了自己的飞船。或许，封存在我们方舟内部的东西，本就注定要助我们一臂之力。或许，它能让我们做好准备，去面对大裂隙另一侧可能存在的任何事物。
entries.en:
For as long as we can remember, the Great Rift has hung before us in the void - a constant presence on the horizon of our journey, as familiar as it is unexplained. Legends propose that our past is intimately entwined with this mysterious celestial scar, and with an ancient impact buried deep within the hull of our arkship.

For generations, the site was revered, but little understood. However, recent fluctuations in the arkship's core systems have drawn attention to long-sealed chambers near the impact point. Preparations are already underway to breach them. Opinions remain divided on what we may uncover there.

Is it simple coincidence that this has occurred at the advent of Hyperdrive technology? Just as we reach for the stars, our attention is pulled back to our own vessel. Perhaps what lies sealed within our arkship is meant to aid us on our journey. Perhaps it can prepare us for whatever lies beyond the Rift.

entries.zh: 我们的社会发展在跨维度存在的影响下，激发出对科学研究进行深化探索的热情。
entries.en: Our societal development under the influence of interdimensional forces drives a fervor for further research.

entries.zh: 从§H[From.solar_system.GetName]§!内星界裂隙的爆炸余波中，我们收到了一段奇怪的通讯。\n\n[GetScientistPlural]们认为它源某个自远超裂隙本身的地方，且目前尚且只破译了其中的只言片语。
entries.en: In the aftermath of the exploration of the Astral Rift in §H[From.solar_system.GetName]§!, a mysterious transmission was received.\n\nOur [GetScientistPlural] have determined its origin to be from beyond the rift itself, and have only been able to translate a few words.

entries.zh: ……与这个位面……同调……我们……会找到你……
entries.en: ...attune... with the planes... we will find you...

entries.zh: 近期的地震活动意外地让一处毗邻我们首都的远古撞击坑显露了其庐山真面目。\n\n这座独一无二的坑洞一定与我们[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]物种的真正起源息息相关。
entries.en: Recent seismic activity has revealed unexpected features of the ancient impact site near our capital.\n\nThis specific crater has been linked to our very origin as [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 我们在[Planet.GetName]地表上的撞击坑的极深处探测到了异常的地震活动。地下声呐发现了一座前所未知的洞穴。
entries.en: We've detected anomalous seismic activity from deep inside an ancient crater on the surface of [Planet.GetName]. Underground sonar revealed a previously unknown cavity.

entries.zh: 在撞击坑底部的初步发掘工作中，我们发现了一条深入地下深层的圆柱体撞击岩。\n\n这一岩层必然源自某种类陨石体的极高速撞击。初步计算表明，该物体几乎是以高亚光速发生的碰撞。它的重见天日宛若奇迹。
entries.en: Initial excavations into the base of the crater revealed a fully-formed cylinder of impactite lodged deep into the earth.\n\nThis vein must have originated from a meteoric impact of extremely high velocity. Initial calculations demonstrate the object must have arrived at a measurable fraction of the speed of light. It's a wonder that it made it to the surface.

entries.zh: 在撞击岩层的终点，我们发现了一座豁然开朗的洞穴系统。\n\n地下水形成的水洼滋养着岩壁上灰暗纤弱的植被。在其中一个水池的地下，静静地躺着一个与众不同的球状物体。显然它不是自然生成的，而是这个撞击点的始作俑者。
entries.en: At the termination point of the impactite vein, we have discovered an expansive cave system.\n\nPools of underground water support thin lines of pale vegetation along the cavern walls. At the bottom of one of these pools lies the remnants of an anomalous spherical object. It is not a natural formation, and appears to be the source of this impact site.

entries.zh:
我们从地下湖中取回了那个球体。

尽管被一些植被覆盖，其大部分仍保持得相当完整。其建造方式怪异地混杂着高度复杂的设计和粗糙的组装。完美光滑的金属板覆盖着舰船的前半部分，可以用来显著降低再入大气时的阻力。

它所处位置的弹道回推与撞击岩处于一条直线上，由此可以确认该球体就是那颗把我们带到此地的类陨石体。
entries.en:
We have recovered the sphere from the underground lake.

While covered in vegetative growth, much of it remains fully intact. Its construction is a strange mix of highly sophisticated design and crude assembly. Perfectly smooth metallic plates cover the frontal portion of the ship, which must have reduced friction significantly upon atmospheric entry.

The trajectory of its resting site aligns with the vein of impactite, confirming that this sphere is the source of the metamorphic rock that led us here. Even more incredibly, there are signs that this vessel had passengers.

entries.zh:
我们在这个远古球体的内部取得了一箱档案文件，上面书写着一种我们语言的远古版本。提到的许多名字与我们最神圣的传说一一对应。

盘根错节的梯道网络从撞击坑底一路蜿蜒崎岖地爬向一座巨大的隧道系统。从其中绳索纤维年代的跨度来看，这些隧道居住过数代人，这些幸存者们一点一点地凿开了通向地表的路。

然而，目前为止的发现都无法让我们对最后一个发现做好心理准备：那是一座包含着一处坟地的洞穴。对其中的遗骸进行基因分析得出了令人惊讶的结果：这些人正是我们的祖先。

至于他们又从何而来，为何此地被遗忘在了历史长河之中，又是新的谜团。抢救出来的档案保存状态不佳，但我们还是从球体中修复了一些数据日志。显然，这艘舰船是通过那道靠近[from.planet.GetName]的星界裂隙来到我们的恒星系的。
entries.en:
We have recovered a cache of documents from within the ancient sphere, each written in an archaic version of our own language. Several of these mention names associated with our most sacred legends.

An intricate network of ladders snakes upward from the impact site to a massive tunnel system. Based on the varying ages of the rope fibers, these caverns must have been occupied for several generations as the crash survivors worked their way toward the surface.

However, nothing we'd discovered thus far could have prepared us for the final revelation: one of the upper chambers contained a burial site. DNA analysis conducted on the remains within revealed a shocking truth: these people are our ancestors.

Where exactly they came from, or why this place was forgotten, is yet unknown. The salvaged documents are in a poorly preserved state, but we have recovered a data log from the sphere. It clearly shows that the vessel arrived in our star system by means of the Astral Rift near [from.planet.GetName].

entries.zh: $astral_planes.2140.desc.common$\n\n尽管显然比我们的科技低级，这座球体正是其建造者渴望和才智的见证。这是一种逃离裂隙另一侧悲惨命运的终极手段。
entries.en: $astral_planes.2140.desc.common$\n\nWhile clearly less advanced than our own tech, this sphere is a testament to its builders desperation and ingenuity. This was a final effort to escape what must have been a terrible fate on the far side of the rift.

entries.zh: $astral_planes.2140.desc.common$\n\n通过一些研究，我们应该能够复制甚至改进用来建造这种具有跨越维度能力的船体的科技。
entries.en: $astral_planes.2140.desc.common$\n\nWith some study, we should be able to replicate and even improve upon the technology required to construct a vessel with these dimension-spanning capabilities.

entries.zh:
我们在远古球体中发现了一台存储器，这个储存器是由我们文件系统的某个上古版本进行编码的。

盘根错节的梯道网络从撞击坑底一路蜿蜒崎岖地爬向一座巨大的隧道系统。从其中缆绳纤维年代的跨度来看，这些隧道曾经容纳过许多次迭代，这些撞击事件的幸存者们一点一点地凿开了通向地表的路。

最靠上的一处遗址包含着一些与我们最早期型号的部件非常相似的东西。这些幸存者应该就是我们的先祖。

至于他们又从何而来，为何此地被遗忘在了历史长河之中尚不得而知。我们从球体中取回的数据清楚地表明，抵达我们星系的这艘球状舰船正是来自[from.planet.GetName]附近的星界裂隙。
entries.en:
We have recovered a data cache from within the ancient sphere, a cache that was encoded in an archaic version of our file system.

An intricate network of ladders snakes upward from the impact site to a massive tunnel system. Based on the varying ages of the rope fibers, these caverns must have been occupied for several iterations as the crash survivors worked their way toward the surface.

One of the upper sites contained parts reminiscent of those used by our earliest models. These survivors were our predecessors.

Where exactly they came from, or why this location was lost, is yet unknown. The data long we recovered from the sphere clearly shows that the vessel arrived in our star system by means of the Astral Rift near [from.planet.GetName].

entries.zh: $astral_planes.2140.desc.machine.common$\n\n虽然显然没有我们自己的技术先进，但这个球体正是其建设者之绝望和创造力的见证。这是他们逃避裂隙彼端骇人命运的最后努力。
entries.en: $astral_planes.2140.desc.machine.common$\n\nWhile clearly less advanced than our own tech, this sphere is a testament to its builders' desperation and ingenuity. This was a final effort to escape what must have been a terrible fate on the far side of the rift.

entries.zh: $astral_planes.2140.desc.machine.common$\n\n通过一些研究，我们应该能够复制甚至改进用来建造这种具有跨越维度能力的船体的科技。
entries.en: $astral_planes.2140.desc.machine.common$\n\nWith some study, we should be able to replicate and even improve upon the technology required to construct a vessel with these dimension-spanning capabilities.

entries.zh: 初锻我们的熔炉找到了。
该政府以互相低于外部威胁作为共同目标将人民团结到一起。
entries.en: This government unites its people in the common cause of protection against external threats.

entries.zh: 该社会以一种深层的灵魂共识作为基石。他们施加严格的道德规范以确保最广大人民能笃信来世。
entries.en: This society is underpinned by a deep spiritual consciousness. Strict moral codes are in place to ensure the highest percentage of its people can confidently look forward to the afterlife.

entries.zh: 在已知的宇宙之外，存在通往其他世界的路径，那些同其他世界相互连接处的构造十分精妙。这就是我们建造最神圣的寺庙的地方。\n
entries.en: Outside the known universe there are pathways to other worlds, and places where those connections are subtly made. This is where we build the holiest of our temples.\n

entries.zh: 为我们的武器组件重新装填保留了恒星基地的重要部分，并提供额外的防御平台。\n
entries.en: Reserves a significant portion of the Starbase for reloading our weapon components, and provides for extra defense platforms.\n

entries.zh: 速度在该社会中是最受欢迎的。对超空间的操控不过是一种上升渠道，让那些在该领域最有天赋的人得以晋升到最高的阶层。
entries.en: This society has always embraced speed. The manipulation of hyperspace is just another thoroughfare, and those with aptitude in the field have risen to the highest caste.

entries.zh: 必有研究选项 £physics£§Y$tech_hyper_drive_2$§!。\n拥有初始星系3跳超空间航道内的星系的低级情报。
entries.en: £physics£ §Y$tech_hyper_drive_2$§! is Guaranteed Research Option.\nHas Low Intel on all systems within 3 Hyperlanes of your starting system.

entries.zh: 该集体追求速度。超空间操控的方法论深深地植根于整个集体之中，使其能够逐步理解距离-时间比的基本原理。
entries.en: This collective seeks speed. The methodologies of hyperspace manipulation are embedded deep throughout the collective, enabling a progressive understanding of the fundamental principles of distance over time.

entries.zh: 这个集合体追求速度。超空间操控的理论深深地蚀刻进入了每个子个体的处理单元中，使得集合体对距离-时间比的基本原则有着不断进步的理解。
entries.en: This collective seeks speed. Theories of hyperspace manipulation are hard-wired into the processing unit of every drone, granting the collective a progressive understanding of the fundamental principles of distance over time.

entries.zh: 时间就是金钱，而这个寰宇企业也非常重视速度。对研发的大量投资已经得到了丰厚的回报，使得该公司拥有了独家使用尖端超空间操纵技术的权限。
entries.en: Time is money, and this Megacorporation values speed. Heavy investment in R&D has paid off handsomely, granting the Corporation proprietary access to cutting-edge hyperspace manipulation techniques.

entries.zh: 这个社会相信，在时空的褶皱之外有着神圣的存在。对他们来说，不稳定度最高的系统具有神圣的意义，既是朝圣地，也是研究的场所。
entries.en: This society believes that a divine existence lies beyond the folds in space and time. Systems where instabilities are highest hold a sacred meaning to them as sites of both pilgrimage and research.

entries.zh: 对宇宙结构的深入理解使得这个社会在超空间引擎的发现之前就能够利用神秘的暗物质特性。
entries.en: A deep understanding of the architecture of the universe allowed this society to exploit the mysterious properties of dark matter long before the discovery of the hyperdrive.

entries.zh: 这个由相互争斗的部落组成的集合，已经在长久的历史上形成了对固守领土和防御姿态的偏好。现在他们团结一致，准备将这种哲学带到星空中，旨在保持他们的边界稳固，并缓和紧张局势。
entries.en: This collection of warring tribes has developed a historical preference for entrenched territories and defensive posturing. Now united, they are prepared to bring this philosophy to the stars, aiming to keep their borders solid and tensions low.

entries.zh: 这个集体已经在长久的历史上形成了对固守领土和防御姿态的偏好。现在他们准备将这种哲学带到星空中，旨在保持他们的边界稳固，并缓和紧张局势。
entries.en: This collective has developed a historical preference for entrenched territories and defensive posturing. They are prepared to bring this philosophy to the stars, aiming to keep their borders solid and tensions low.

entries.zh: 这个机械集体已经在长久的历史上形成了对固守领土和防御姿态的偏好。现在他们准备将这种哲学带到星空中，旨在保持他们的边界稳固，并缓和紧张局势。
entries.en: This mechanical collective has developed a procedural preference for entrenched territories and defensive posturing. They are prepared to bring this effective strategy to the stars, aiming to keep their borders solid and tensions low.

entries.zh: 这个由相互竞争的企业构成的社会已经认识到，对于他们的投资来说，最好的保护是强大的防御姿态。现在团结一致，他们准备将这一理念带到星空中，旨在保持边境稳固，缓解紧张局势。
entries.en: This society of competing industries has learned that the best protection for their investments is a strong defensive posturing. Now united, they are prepared to bring this philosophy to the stars, aiming to keep their borders solid and tensions low.

entries.zh: 坚守我们家园的坚忍护卫者，这些士兵在保护与他们有密切关系的人时最具有战斗力。
entries.en: Stoic defenders of our homeland, these unshakeable soldiers are most effective when protecting those with whom they share a close relationship.

entries.zh: 这些高度致命的保护性无人机在与所有其他战略节点保持紧密接触时效果最好。
entries.en: These highly lethal protective drones are most effective when kept in close proximity to all other strategic nodes.

entries.zh: 暗物质处理单元提供的电子模糊性产生了即使最优秀的代码破解者也难以应对的软件。
entries.en: The electronic obscurity provided by dark matter processing units generates software that even the best codebreakers must struggle with.

entries.zh: 在森林中隐藏自己，应该覆没泥土。在太空中隐藏自己，应该身披虚空。
entries.en: To hide in a forest, one should wear the earth. To hide in space, one should wear the void.

entries.zh: 暗物质作为我们铸造厂的助熔剂具有独特的结合性能，可以显著增加产量。
entries.en: The unique binding properties of dark matter as a flux in our foundries increases the yield by appreciable amounts.

entries.zh: 暗物质所构成的键中所蕴含的能量可以被拆出，得到有价值的产物。
entries.en: The energy contained within bonds formed by dark matter can be unraveled into a valuable output.

entries.zh: 过度扩张自己的国境线会带来各种风险。了解自己是一种更可靠和有成效的努力。
entries.en: Overextension of one's boundaries introduces a variety of risks. Understanding oneself is a more reliable and productive endeavor.

entries.zh: 为了更深入地理解宇宙的织构，我们必须超越原子的概念。
entries.en: For a deeper understanding of the weave of the universe, we must look beyond the notion of the atom.

entries.zh: $TITLE$有助于确保我们的星际后勤网络的安全保障。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ helps ensure the safety and security of our interstellar logistics network.

entries.en: Each §Y$sm_warp_fluctuator$§! starbase building also provides §G+$@councilor_hyperspace_specialty_warp_fluctuator_stability$§! £stability£ Stability

entries.zh: $TITLE$将统一我们的祭司团，以单一的指导愿景为人民提供更好的服务。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ unify our priesthood under a single guiding vision in order to better serve our people.

entries.zh: $TITLE$的职责是对每一单元暗物质进行归档记账，确保没有一个粒子会被浪费。
entries.en: The $TITLE$'s duties lie in accounting for each and every unit of dark matter, ensuring not a single particle is wasted.

entries.zh: 一个备受推崇的保卫我们家园的专家，$TITLE$负责所有要塞驻地的安全和维护。
entries.en: A highly regarded expert at protecting our homeland, the $TITLE$ is responsible for the safety and maintenance for all of our fortifications.

entries.zh: 一个备受推崇的保卫我们家园的专家，$TITLE$负责所有要塞驻地的账目和后勤。
entries.en: A highly regarded expert at protecting our homeland, the $TITLE$ is responsible for the accounting and logistics for all of our fortifications.

entries.zh: 有机物质的聚集体，无论放置在哪，都会进行野蛮的生长和扩张。
entries.en: A cluster of organic material that aggressively spreads wherever it is placed.

entries.zh: 培育一位新的领袖。此人将不需要维护费用，并且不会计入领袖总数。
entries.en: Grow a new leader. They will have no upkeep and will not count towards your leader total.

entries.zh: 被封印的水晶舱室，内含一个与外界隔绝的时间循环。
entries.en: A sealed crystal chamber containing an isolated temporal loop.

entries.zh: 这个先进的设备能够以与附近的时空褶皱共振的频率振动，暂时封闭它们。
entries.en: This advanced device is able to vibrate at a frequency that resonates with nearby folds in space and time, sealing them temporarily.

entries.en: Place a Lock on all Wormholes and L-gates within your borders for §Y5§! years.

entries.zh: §Y5§!年内关闭你的方舟舰所在恒星系的所有虫洞和L-星门。
entries.en: Place a Lock on all Wormholes and L-gates within the same system as our Arkships for §Y5§! years.

entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$There are no wormholes or L-gates within your borders.

entries.zh: 一个高维的旋转陀螺。它的流动无缝而催人入眠；是一种永恒的完美运动。
entries.en: An extra-dimensional spinning top. Its flow is seamless, hypnotic; perfect motion in perpetuity.

entries.zh: 来自某个悲伤天体的一滴星界眼泪的样本。它离活跃的恒星越近，发光就越明亮。
entries.en: A sample of an astral teardrop from a mourning celestial body. The closer it is placed to an active sun, the brighter it glows.

entries.en: Habitability of Arkships in systems with §YA§!, §YB§!, §YF§!, and §YG§! class stars: §G+5%§!

entries.en: The nucleus of a giant cell from an alien dimension. A reminder of the infinite diversity of organic life.

entries.en: Gives a random leader 3 random positive traits.

entries.zh: 一个超维时序机制的j金色核心，这个非凡的装置能够像操纵它的齿轮一样操纵时间。
entries.en: The golden core of an extradimensional timing mechanism, this remarkable device has the ability to manipulate time as if it were yet another of its gears.

entries.zh: 一个能够赐予永恒生命的超维港口。被它影响的人存在于一个没有恐惧、奇迹或结局的现实中。
entries.en: An extradimensional harbor capable of granting eternal life. Those who are touched by its influence exist in a reality free from fear, wonder, or conclusion.

entries.zh: 一个神秘的物体出现了。我们相信我们对时空裂缝的探索引起了某个人或某个东西的注意。
entries.en: A mysterious object has appeared. We believe our exploration into the rifts between space and time has drawn the attention of someone, or something.

entries.zh: 我们没有获得必要的§Y$tech_rift_sphere$§!科技去正确地开展我们的研究。
entries.en: We do not possess the §Y$tech_rift_sphere$§! technology necessary to correctly carry on with our research.

entries.zh: 我们必须消灭最后的入侵者，才能让无形异使正确地封印[Root.Target.GetName]恒星系。
entries.en: We must eliminate the last of the invaders for the Formless to properly seal the [Root.Target.GetName] system

entries.zh: 我们的工程师相信，如果我们引爆一系列受控的爆炸物，我们将达到一个共振频率，这将完全粉碎水晶球。
entries.en: Our engineers believe if we detonate a controlled series of explosives, we will achieve a resonance frequency which will shatter the crystal sphere entirely.

entries.zh: 星界丝缕能够在这个装置的晶体结构中穿梭，从内部削弱它。
entries.en: Astral thread is able to slip within the crystalline structure of this device to weaken it from within.

entries.zh: 如果我们成功摧毁这个设备，我们将能够利用它的组件材料，同时防止我们帝国面临任何进一步的危险。
entries.en: If we succeed in destroying this device, we will be able to exploit its component materials while at the same time preventing any further danger to our empire.

entries.zh: 这个设备似乎正在慢慢调整自己。我们相信，随着时间的推移，它将完成它被设计去执行的任务。
entries.en: The device seems to be slowly aligning itself. We believe that, over time, it will accomplish what it was designed to do.

entries.zh: 如果我们能够投入足够的科学研究来开发这个设备的潜力，我们相信可以加速其激活。
entries.en: If we were to dedicate enough scientific research to unlocking the potential of this device, we believe we can accelerate its activation.

entries.zh: 星界丝缕似乎可以对这个装置进行刺激。我们刺激得越多，它激活得就越快。
entries.en: Astral thread seems to stimulate the device. The more we expose it to, the faster its activation.

entries.zh: 这个设备似乎正在以某种仔细考量的方式慢慢调整自己。我们相信，随着时间的推移，它将完成它被设计去执行的任务。
entries.en: The device seems to be aligning itself slowly in a deliberate fashion. We believe that, over time, it will accomplish what it was designed to do.

entries.zh: 如果我们能够投入足够的科学研究来开发这个设备的潜力，我们相信可以加速其激活。
entries.en: If we were to dedicate enough scientific research to unlocking the potential of this device, we believe we can accelerate its activation.

entries.zh: 星界丝缕似乎可以对这个装置进行刺激。我们刺激得越多，它激活得就越快。
entries.en: Astral thread seems to stimulate the device. The more we expose it to, the faster its activation.

entries.zh: 我们不确定这个装置可能包含什么秘密。\n\n我们谨慎乐观地认为，在检查完它的结构后，我们将能够进一步推进我们的社会进步。
entries.en: We are uncertain what secrets this device may contain.\n\nWe are cautiously optimistic that we will be able to advance our society further after examining its construction.

entries.zh: 星系中心的居民目前遭受一股未知势力的攻击，他们请求我们的帮助。如果他们失败，我们或许就再也无法知晓自己的命运。
entries.en: Under assault from an unknown force, the entities currently inhabiting the center of the galaxy have requested our assistance. Should they fall, we know not our fate.

entries.zh: 我们目前不会采取任何特殊行动。
entries.en: We will take no special actions here.

entries.zh: 位于§H$NAME_Formless_System$§!恒星系的所有友方舰船获得§G+50%§!护盾值。
entries.en: §G+50%§! Shield Hit Points on all friendly ships in the §H$NAME_Formless_System$§! system.

entries.zh: 位于§H$NAME_Formless_System$§!恒星系的所有友方舰船获得§G+10%§!能量武器伤害。
entries.en: §G+10%§! Energy Weapon Damage for all friendly ships in the §H$NAME_Formless_System$§! system.

entries.zh: 如果我们拯救了这些生命体，我们不确定会有什么结果。
entries.en: We are uncertain what will result, should we choose to save these beings.

entries.zh: 我们不进行干涉，任由冲突演变。
entries.en: We will let this conflict proceed without interference.

entries.zh: 如果我们将自己回收的星界丝缕交给这些存在，他们可以用它来加强自己的护盾。
entries.en: If we were to deliver our recovered astral thread to these beings, they could use it to fortify their shielding.

entries.zh: 异星天然气在这个存在的古怪泡泡中有放大效果。我们可以利用它来增强我们的武器。
entries.en: Exotic gases have amplified effects in this strange bubble of existence. We can use it to enhance our weaponry.

entries.zh: 如果我们将自己回收的星界丝缕交给这些存在，他们可以运用自己对其性质的丰厚知识来加强自己的护盾。
entries.en: If we were to deliver our recovered astral thread to these beings, they could use their intimate knowledge of its properties to fortify their shielding.

entries.zh: 异星天然气在这个存在的古怪泡泡中有放大效果。我们可以利用它来增强我们的武器。
entries.en: Exotic gases have amplified effects in this strange bubble of existence. We can use it to enhance our weaponry.

entries.zh: 下一批背道者舰队将会在[this.days_before_spawn]出现。
entries.en: The next Aberrant Fleet will spawn on [this.days_before_spawn].

entries.zh:
结束了。

水晶球体已经被打碎成无数闪闪发光的碎屑。

我们立即回收了数量丰富的珍贵材料。它的基本元素与我们以往所遇到的任何东西都不同。

我们的人民正在庆祝这一保护我们家园安全的激进决定。让这样的装置留在我们的边境上是不负责任的。
entries.en:
It is done.

The Crystalline Sphere has been shattered into innumerable glittering grains.

We immediately harvested the bounty of valuable material. Its base elements are unlike anything we have ever encountered before.

Our people are celebrating the bold decision to maintain the safety and security of our home. Allowing such a device to remain within our borders would have been irresponsible.

entries.zh:
这是一条消息。

刻录在晶体内部的某个不可能存在的网络中，有一组指令。

我们严格按照指令去做，成功地再造了蚀刻在晶体球周围所暗示的条件。一种精确的气体和星界丝缕的排列已经起到了“激活”这个球体的作用。

随后，它突然消失了。取而代之的是一个我们从未见过的星界裂隙凝聚而成的景象。

它的存在邀请我们去探索。
entries.en:
It is a message.

Encoded within an impossible network of crystal, there were a set of instructions.

Followed to the letter, we were able to recreate the conditions inscribed around the crystal sphere. A precise arrangement of gases and astral thread have worked to 'activate' the sphere.

Shortly afterwards, it simply disappeared. In its place, an Astral Rift unlike anything we have ever seen coalesced into view.

Its existence invites exploration.

entries.zh:
一个奇怪的物体已经到达[Root.Capital.GetName]的轨道上。

这个晶态球形物体让人想起我们自己的§Y$tech_rift_sphere$§!技术，它突然出现在没有任何已知轨迹的地方。

由于与[Root.Capital.GetName]如此接近，这个球体可能对我们的人民构成重大威胁。

另一方面，它很有可能包含有关维度旅行性质的珍贵线索。
entries.en:
A strange object has arrived in orbit of [Root.Capital.GetName].

A crystalline sphere reminiscent of our own §Y$tech_rift_sphere$§! technology, it appeared without warning along no known trajectory.

At such close proximity to [Root.Capital.GetName], the sphere may represent a significant danger to our people.

On the other hand, it is also highly likely to contain valuable insights into the nature of dimensional travel.

entries.zh:
我们已经控制了[crystal_sphere_system.GetName]轨道上的一个奇怪物体。

这是一个晶态球状物体，与我们开发的§Y$tech_rift_sphere$§!技术极其相似，该技术使我们能够探索其他维度。

它可能对我们的帝国构成重大的未知危险。

另一方面，我们相信它可能包含一些有价值的关于维度旅行的珍贵线索。
entries.en:
We have taken control of a strange object in the orbit of [crystal_sphere_system.GetName].

It is a crystalline spherical object most similar to the §Y$tech_rift_sphere$§! technology we have developed that allows us to explore other dimensions.

It may present a significant unknown danger to our empire.

On the other hand, we believe it might contain some valuable insights into dimensional travel.

entries.zh:
鉴于我们最近对星界裂隙的研究，我们发现位于[crystal_sphere_system.GetName]的晶态球状物体与我们开发的§Y$tech_rift_sphere$§!技术有很多相似之处。

它可能对我们的帝国构成重大未知危险。

另一方面，我们相信它可能包含一些有关维度旅行的珍贵线索。
entries.en:
In light of our recent research into Astral Rifts, we have discovered that the crystalline spherical object in [crystal_sphere_system.GetName] bares many similarities to the §Y$tech_rift_sphere$§! technology we have developed.

It may present a significant unknown danger to our empire.

On the other hand, we believe it might contain some valuable insights into dimensional travel.

entries.zh: 我们已经控制了[crystal_sphere_system.GetName]轨道上的一个奇怪物体。\n\n我们对它的目的和来源不甚知晓。或许，借由未来研究的进展，我们能够找到如何使用它的线索。
entries.en: We have taken control of a strange object in the orbit of [crystal_sphere_system.GetName].\n\nWe are unsure of its purpose or origin. Perhaps with some future research we can gain insight on how to approach it.

entries.zh: 我们会时刻注意观察它。
entries.en: We'll keep an eye on it.

entries.zh: 这个恒星系中的天体环绕的是一个星界裂隙，而不是一颗恒星。
entries.en: In place of a star, the celestial bodies in this system orbit an ancient Astral Rift.

entries.zh: 无形异使的母星，通过某种未知的手段锚定在这里。
entries.en: The homeworld of the Formless, anchored here by some unknown means.

entries.zh: 来自其他维度的新物种定居在了[this.GetName]。
entries.en: New species from another dimension have settled on [this.GetName].

entries.zh: $habitat_complex$建设在一个可开采的星界丝缕贮藏附近。
entries.en: This $habitat_complex$ is built near an exploitable Astral Threads deposit.

entries.zh: 该恒星系包含一个通往$DEST|Y$的§Y$STRANGE_WORMHOLE$§!
entries.en: This system contains a §Y$STRANGE_WORMHOLE$§! connected to $DEST|Y$

entries.zh: 该恒星系内包含一个§R未探索的§!§Y$STRANGE_WORMHOLE$§!
$TRIGGER_FAIL$§R某些外部势力正在阻止我们进入。§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§RSome outside force is preventing our entrance.§!

entries.zh: 我们从未见过这种类型的虫洞。
entries.en: We have never seen this type of wormhole before.

entries.zh:
在§H[From.GetName]§!内附近的§H晶体裂隙§!处出现了一个异常的虫洞。

我们只能推测这是无形异使打开的一个星门，为他们带来援军。我们检测到另一侧的恒星系已经从其他地方被拉入我们的位面。

如果我们选择进入这个地方，我们应该准备我们最强大的舰队。
entries.en:
An anomalous wormhole has appeared nearby the §HCrystal Rift§!, in §H[From.GetName]§!.

We can only assume that it is a gateway opened by the Formless to bring them aid. We detect the system on the other side has been pulled into our dimension from somewhere else.

We should prepare our strongest fleets if we choose to enter this place.

entries.zh: 我们发现了一个异常的虫洞。无论我们的舰船试图靠近多近，都会被一股未知的力量推开。在§H[From.GetName]§!恒星系中发生了非常奇怪的事情。
entries.en: We have discovered an anomalous wormhole. No matter how close our vessels attempt to proceed, we are being repelled by an unknown force. Something very odd is happening in the §H[From.GetName]§! system.

entries.zh: 我们在§H[From.GetName]§!发现了一个异常的虫洞。传感器显示它直接通往星系的中心。这怎么可能？
entries.en: We have discovered an anomalous wormhole in §H[From.GetName]§!. Sensors detect it is a direct pathway to the center of the galaxy. How is that possible?

entries.zh: 我们在§H[crystal_sphere_system.GetName]§!恒星系中发现的异常虫洞正在剧烈波动。传感器检测到它是通往星系中心的直接通道。\n\n这怎么可能？
entries.en: The anomalous wormhole we discovered in the §H[crystal_sphere_system.GetName]§! system is fluctuating wildly. Sensors detect it is a direct pathway to the center of the galaxy.\n\nHow is that possible?

entries.zh:
这个虫洞的另一边似乎把我们带到了……星系的中心？

我们不应该存在于这里，更别说整个恒星系了。也许有一些维度操控在起作用吗？

我们没有太多时间来调查，因为我们正在接收来自一个未知实体的传输信号。
entries.en:
The other side of this wormhole seems to have taken us to... the center of the galaxy?

It should not be possible for us to exist here, let alone an entire system. Is there perhaps some dimensional manipulation at play?

We have little time to investigate, as we are receiving transmissions from an unknown entity.

entries.zh: 这是什么……你带来了什么傻瓜来帮助你，沙达衮？或者……你给我们提供了食物……
entries.en: what is this... what fools have you brought to aid you, shadagon? or perhaps... you have offered us food...

entries.zh: 我们被当作猎物，被诱惑到此地？
entries.en: Have we been lured here as prey?

entries.zh: 我们的舰队已经击败了守卫这个裂隙的奇怪船只，但似乎它们并不孤单。\n\n我们收到了一段传输信号，来源于这个恒星系唯一行星旁边的建筑物内的存在。
entries.en: Our fleets have defeated the strange ships guarding this rift, but it seems they were not alone.\n\nWe have received a transmission from beings inhabiting a structure nearby the lone planet in this system.

entries.zh: 更多的即将到来……我们必须封闭这个裂缝……我们是唯一剩下的人……
entries.en: more are coming... we must seal this rift... we are all that remains...

entries.zh: 我们是唯一剩下的人……我们必须重建……我们需要时间……
entries.en: we are all that remains... we must rebuild... we need time...

entries.zh: 如果我们能够提供大量的星界丝缕，这些生物肯定能够增强他们的防御能力。
entries.en: If we were to deliver a large amount of astral thread, these beings could surely enhance their defenses.

entries.zh: 无形异使没有剩余舰队。
entries.en: The Formless have no fleets remaining.

entries.zh: 最后……退位……我们的链条被打破……目睹我们的上升……我们将找到他们隐藏的东西……
entries.en: finally... abdication... our chains are broken... behold our ascension... we will find what they have hidden...

entries.zh: 被我们所知为无形异使的存在，已经被来自另一个位面的攻击者摧毁。位于$NAME_Formless_System$恒星系的传送门也被封印关闭。
entries.en: The beings known as the Formless have been destroyed by attackers from another dimension. The portal into the $NAME_Formless_System$ system has sealed shut.

entries.zh: §H在不断变化的状态下，这个实体的可见形态在这个现实和另一个现实之间转换。祂的声音共鸣如众多的和声，仿佛同时代表着几个存在。§!\n\n……完成了……封印已经设置完毕……我们的孩子再也找不到这个地方了……
entries.en: §HIn a constant state of flux, this entity's visible form shifts between this reality and another. Their voice resonates as a harmonic multitude, as speaking on behalf of several beings at once.§!\n\n... it is done... the seal is set... never shall our children find this place again...

entries.zh: 你知道我们……我们超越了裂缝……也属于裂缝……你已经见过了……
entries.en: you know us... we are beyond the rifts... and of the rifts... you have seen...

entries.zh: 我们的孩子……破碎的孩子……追捕我们……他们寻找王座……我们隐藏它……
entries.en: our children... broken children... hunt us... they seek the throne... we hide it...

entries.zh: 我们的永恒……我们的回忆……如果我们是血液……那就是心脏……现在安全了……我们感谢你……
entries.en: our eternity... our memories... if we are the blood... it is the heart... safe now... we thank you...

entries.zh: §Y向我们臣服，你们将继续存活。§!
entries.en: §YServe under us, and you may yet still live.§!

entries.zh: §Y$NAME_Formless$§!作为一个§Y$preset_luminarium$§!成为§Y[This.GetName]§!治下的附属国。
entries.en: §Y$NAME_Formless$§! becomes a subject under §Y[This.GetName]§! as a §Y$preset_luminarium$§!.

entries.zh: 这已经被预测……我们会向你们称臣……这是我们的命运……
entries.en: this was predicted... we will serve you... this is our fate...

entries.zh: 我们误判了你……极度悲伤……让它结束吧……
entries.en: we have misjudged you... great sorrow... let it be done...
the eternal throne... it is not yours to take...\n$astral_planes.3102.desc.fail$

entries.zh: 将一支无形异使舰队交由你控制。
entries.en: Grants a Formless fleet under your control.

entries.zh: 获得一个随机物理学科技。

§Y$NAME_Formless_leader$§!……永恒王座的建筑师……

祂花费了千年时间来制作……

一个将我们紧密联系在一起的装置……精致而永远……

它最适合为您服务……

再没有比您更聪明的了……
entries.en:
§Y$NAME_Formless_leader$§!... architect of the eternal throne...

it is that one that spent millennia in its making...

a device to bind us as one... delicate and forever...

that one is best suited to serve you...

there are none left more clever...

entries.zh:
遗憾……

然而已经预见……

命运……

无需哀悼。

沙巴纳什……破碎的亲人……永远饥饿……

我们的贪婪……被放大……

罪恶被揭示……

一个巨大的耻辱……
entries.en:
shabanash... shattered kin... hungry always...

our greed... amplified...

sins brought to light...

a great shame...

entries.zh:
达伽尔……无视……充满愤怒……

我们的愤怒……显现……

他们的冲突永远不会结束……
entries.en:
dagaal... heedless... filled with rage...

our wrath... manifest...

their conflicts will never end...

entries.zh:
盎宰……王座的追求者……

巨大的嫉妒……

我们被遗忘的概念……
entries.en:
onzai... seekers of the throne...

great envy...

our forgotten concept...
We'd like to ask something else.

entries.zh:
我们知道的方法.……这是一个……频率的问题……？

你的语言中没有这个词……

我们需要……星界材料……
entries.en:
we know of ways... it is a matter of... frequencies...?

your language does not have the word...

we require... astral material...

entries.zh: 完成了……你的调谐已经完工……
entries.en: it is done... your attunement is complete...

entries.zh:
沙达衮的§Y$NAME_Formless_leader$§!……你怎么会在这里……

你将成为一顿盛宴……

来吧，与我们一同碰撞……
entries.en:
§Y$NAME_Formless_leader$§! of shadagon... how is it you are here...

you will be a great feast...

come and break against us...

entries.zh:
我们还没有结束……沙达衮的§Y$NAME_Formless_leader$§!……

你救了你的亲族……但愚蠢地追求……傲慢……

见证愤怒……然后是遗忘……
entries.en:
we are not finished... §Y$NAME_Formless_leader$§! of shadagon...

you have saved your kin... but foolishly pursue... hubris...

witness fury... then oblivion...

entries.zh:
建筑师……沙达衮的§Y$NAME_Formless_leader$§!……

我们将吞食你……吸收你的思维……

王座的秘密……你提供的伟大礼物……

现在加入我们……我们将尊重你……
entries.en:
the architect... §Y$NAME_Formless_leader$§! of shadagon...

we will consume you...  incorporate your mind...

the secrets of the throne... a great gift you offer...

join us now... we will honor you...

entries.zh: 无形异使提供给我们一个奖励。
entries.en: The Formless have offered us a reward.

entries.zh: 位于我们星系中心的存在对我们的帮助表示感激，并承诺不时向我们送上礼物。
entries.en: The beings at the center of our galaxy are grateful for our assistance, and have pledged to send us gifts from time to time.

entries.zh: 无形异使的最后一位领袖之一，这个高维实体指挥舰队的时间比大多数物种的寿命还要长。
entries.en: One of the last leaders of the Formless, this extra-dimensional entity has commanded fleets for longer than the lifetime of most species.

entries.zh: 我们针对无形异使的侵略行动，已经导致[this.GetName]放弃将舰队委任给我们，这些舰队重新加入他们的队列。
entries.en: Our aggressive campaign against the Formless has caused [this.GetName] to abandon their assigned fleets, and rejoin their ranks.

entries.zh: 我们已成功消灭了在[event_target:formless_system.GetName]中剩下的最后一批无形异使。\n\n剩下的只有一个神秘的装置。一个人只需将自己的[this.species.GetHandNamePlural]放在上面，就能激活它神奇的再生特性。该装置作为一种通道进入星界位面，其中有大量的超维材料经由它自由流动。
entries.en: We have successfully exterminated the last of the remaining Formless in [event_target:formless_system.GetName].\n\nAll that remains is a mysterious device. One need simply place their [this.species.GetHandNamePlural] upon it to activate its miraculous regenerative properties. The device functions as a sort of conduit into the astral planes, with incredible quantities of extra-dimensional material flowing freely throughout it.

entries.zh: 尽管我们知道你……\n此刻尚未到我们相遇之时……
entries.en: though we know you...\nit is not our time to meet...

entries.zh: 被称为无形异使的存在所拥有的最后堡垒。在他们的庇护下，其他维度的物种会逐渐于此定居下来。
entries.en: The last bastion of the beings known as the Formless. Other-dimensional species will be settled here from time to time under their protection.

entries.zh: 在这个行星上生成来自另一物种的§Y500§!£pop£§H人口§!
entries.en: Spawn §Y500§! £pop£ §HPops§! from another species on this planet

entries.zh: 曙光境是永恒王座的所有者所创造的附属国类型。无形异使的跨次元帝国业已灰飞烟灭，拥有了王座便可驱使他们。
entries.en: A Luminarium is a subject type created by the owner of the Eternal Throne. Those who claim this seat hold influence over the Formless, whose dimension-spanning empire has since fallen into ruin.

entries.zh: 事关暗物质的操控，还有十分强力的应用我们尚未完全探索。
entries.en: There are powerful applications we have not yet fully explored in the manipulation of Dark Matter.

entries.en: §RLocks §Y$civic_dark_consortium$§! civic, preventing it from being reformed.§!

entries.zh: 我们发现了一个时空中的异常裂缝。我们越靠近，已知的物理相对论定律越不适用。\n\n研究这一现象很可能将推动我们对宇宙机制的科学理解提升到一个更高的水平。
entries.en: We have discovered an anomalous rift in space and time. The closer we get, the less the known laws of physical relativity hold purchase.\n\nStudying this phenomenon could very well push our scientific understanding of the mechanics of the universe to a higher level.

entries.zh:
我们已经完成了对位于§Y[FromFrom.System.GetName]§!的§Y$pc_astral_scar$§!的分析。

它正在从其他地方向我们的宇宙泄漏物质。裂缝周围的物质并不是守恒的——至少从我们的测量方法上来说不是的。尽管处于相对微小的规模，但裂缝似乎增加了我们宇宙的总物质量。

研究这一现象应该能更好地理解这种无法解释的能源来源。
entries.en:
We have completed our analysis of the §Y$pc_astral_scar$§! in §Y[FromFrom.System.GetName]§!.

It is leaking material into our universe from... somewhere else. Matter is not being conserved around the rift - at least not in any way that we can measure. Though on a relatively minute scale, somehow the rift is increasing the overall mass of our universe.

Researching this phenomenon should provide a greater understanding of this unaccounted for source of energy.

entries.zh: 我们发现了一处时空的异常裂缝。研究它的独特性质应该能够提供我们有价值的科学启发。
entries.en: We have discovered an anomalous rift in space and time. Researching its unique properties should provide valuable scientific insight.

entries.zh: 我们已经确认了在§Y[FromFromFrom.System.GetName]§!恒星系中存在一个我们宇宙之外的宇宙。\n\n通过裂缝，它的物质位面对我们自己的宇宙施加了巨大的压力，所造成的结果是有一小部分但稳定的物质流动。这一情况的长期效应我们尚未被理解，但在此期间，我们应继续分析其宇宙流出物。
entries.en: We have confirmed the existence of another universe beyond our own in the §Y[FromFromFrom.System.GetName]§! system.\n\nThrough the rift, its physical dimensions are placing immense pressure on our own universe, the result of which is a small though steady flow of material. The long-term effects are yet to be understood, but in the meantime we should continue analyzing its cosmic effluence.

entries.zh: 另一边存在着怎样的奇景呢？
不稳定的引力异常正在从[From.System.GetName]的§Y$pc_astral_scar$§!中泄漏出来，显现为缓慢移动的奇点在附近空间中传播，然后剧烈地内爆。穿越这个恒星系的舰船可以避开它们，但必须小心谨慎地行驶。\n\n进一步调查这种情况，可能能够发现稳定维度裂口的方法。
entries.en: Unstable gravitational anomalies are leaking out of the §Y$pc_astral_scar$§! in [From.System.GetName], manifesting as slow-moving singularities that travel throughout nearby space before violently imploding. Ships passing through this system can avoid them, but must travel more carefully to do so.\n\nInvestigating this situation further could reveal a way to restabilize the dimensional opening.

entries.zh:
经过仔细分析，我们确认[From.System.GetName]中的§Y$pc_astral_scar$§!异常不稳定，需要立即干预以防止该恒星系进一步坍缩为引力奇点。

可以考虑将大量喷射而出的§Y$astral_threads$§!进行重定向、重新利用，以便“缝合”裂痕。这将修复时空的撕裂，并可能留下大量的星界物质。

或者，我们可以投射大量军火来扩大这处裂痕。我们预测，这么做将有助于我们探索伤痕另一边可能存在的事物。
entries.en:
After careful analysis, we've confirmed that the §Y$pc_astral_scar$§! in [From.System.GetName] is dangerously unstable and requires immediate intervention to prevent further gravitational singularities forming in this system.

The powerful ejection of §Y$astral_threads$§! could be redirected and repurposed in order to 'stitch' the scar shut. This would repair the tear in space-time and likely leave behind a significant amount of astral material.

Alternatively, we could deliver a heavy payload of ordinance in an effort to widen the scar. We speculate that this would also allow for further exploration of what may be on the other side.

entries.zh: 经过对其撕裂织构的精细操控，我们成功地完全封印了位于[From.System.GetName]的§Y$pc_astral_scar$§!。引力异常自那时起停止，我们在整个过程中回收了大量的§Y$astral_threads$§!。\n\n无论裂缝另一边的现实如何，都不再对我们构成威胁。
entries.en: After careful manipulation of its torn fabric, we've managed to fully seal the §Y$pc_astral_scar$§! in [From.System.GetName]. Gravitational anomalies have since stopped, and we've recovered a significant quantity of §Y$astral_threads$§! in the process.\n\nWhatever reality was on the other side will no longer pose a danger to our own.

entries.zh: 我们投送到到[From.System.GetName]的§Y$pc_astral_scar$§!核心的军火扩大了时空的折叠。这里曾经只是宇宙织物中的一个小撕裂口，现在成为了一个更大的裂隙，能够让我们进入探索。\n\n由此带来的稳定性使引力异常减弱，我们准备去发现隐藏在其中的事物。
entries.en: The ordinance we sent into the core of the §Y$pc_astral_scar$§! in [From.System.GetName] has widened the folds in space and time. Where there was once a small tear in the cosmic fabric, there is now a larger rift that we are capable of exploring.\n\nThe resulting stability has caused the gravitational anomalies to subside, and we are prepared to discover what lies beyond.

entries.zh: 位于[FromFromFromFrom.System.GetName]的§Y$pc_astral_scar$§!已经朝内坍缩了，并朝周边恒星系抛射出了大量的$astral_threads$。这里的宇宙织构曾经出现过一处小小的撕裂，但如今已经是虚无的太空。\n\n无论裂缝另一边的现实如何，都不再对我们构成威胁。
entries.en: The §Y$pc_astral_scar$§! in [FromFromFromFrom.System.GetName] has collapsed inwardly, ejecting a significant amount of $astral_threads$ into the nearby system. Where there was once a small tear in the cosmic fabric, there is now empty space.\n\nWhatever reality was on the other side will no longer pose a danger to our own.

entries.zh: §Y[from.System.GetName]§!的一颗小行星内我们探测到了一个光亮四溢的物体。\n\n由高度先进材料构建，它正在所有频率上广播稳定的无线电波。我们的扫描仪显示其内部没有含有爆炸性或挥发性化合物。看起来我们可以安全接近并进一步开展研究。
entries.en: A brightly lit object has been detected on an asteroid in §Y[from.System.GetName]§!.\n\nConstructed of highly advanced materials, it is broadcasting a steady stream of radio waves on all frequencies. Our scanners indicate no explosive or volatile compounds contained within. It seems safe to approach and study further.
The Greatest Show in the Multiverse

entries.zh:
我们在这颗小行星上发现的发光物体是一则广告。

这个巨大的展示装置由内部占据小行星的机械基础设施支持。小行星本身在空间中的某一点上异常地悬浮着，不受任何附近物体的引力影响。

广告本身是关于它所称之为“多重宇宙的最佳秀场”的内容。有一个终端可以接受能量币，使我们直接前往这个景点。
entries.en:
The brightly lit object we discovered on this asteroid is an advertisement.

This massive display is supported by a mechanical infrastructure occupying the inside of the asteroid it is mounted on. The asteroid itself is anomalously suspended at one point in space, unaffected by the gravitational pull of any nearby object.

The advertisement itself is in reference to what it calls "The Greatest Show in the Multiverse".There is a terminal accepting energy credits for direct transport to the attraction.

entries.zh: 重新改造这处标识为我们自己所用。
entries.en: Repurpose the sign for our own use.

entries.zh: 在处理完我们的支付款项后，小行星内部的机械开始嗡嗡作响。一股刺眼的蓝光向外射出，精确地分开了时空的织构。当它运转结束时，小行星就消失了，而一道星界裂隙出现在了原地。
entries.en: After processing our payment, the machinery within the asteroid whirred into life. A stream of piercing blue light shot outward, meticulously parting the fabric of space and time. Once its work was finished, the asteroid simply vanished, and an Astral Rift was left in its stead.

entries.zh: 我们用深受认可的本地企业代替了[fromfrom.GetName]的古怪广告商。支付终端被仔细拆解后，我们在里面发现了一小批能量币。
entries.en: We have replaced the anomalous advertisement with an endorsement for our own local businesses at [fromfrom.GetName]. The payment terminal was carefully dismantled, revealing a small cache of energy credits within.

entries.zh: 小行星内部机械中所采纳的技术比我们最初预料的要先进。因此，我们的回收工作给我们带来了相当可观的价值。我们发现了各种稀有材料——其中包括数量惊人的§Y$astral_threads$§!。这颗中空的小行星一定是被设计成能够以某种方式操纵空间和时间。
entries.en: The technology within the asteroid's internal mechanisms were more advanced than initially suspected. As such, its salvage has rewarded us with considerable value. We have uncovered a variety of rare materials - including an anomalous quantity of §Y$astral_threads$§!. The hollowed asteroid must have been designed to manipulate space and time in some fashion.

entries.zh: 我们得好好利用这一切。
entries.en: We shall put these to good use.

entries.zh: 我们的扫描仪检测到了[from.System.GetName]恒星系中黑洞的物理特性与预期相比存在显著偏差。它的引力不可预测的，这导致空间中一个点到另一个点在时间上表现出显著的不一致性。
entries.en: Our scanners have detected significant deviations from the expected physical properties of the black hole in the [from.System.GetName] system. Its gravitational forces are unpredictable, resulting in noticeable temporal inconsistencies from one point in space to another.

entries.zh:
某些由[from.System.GetName]的黑洞释放的粒子实际上是§Y$astral_threads$§!。这意味着在某个时间点，星界细缝被拉入了黑洞的奇点，然后现在正在缓慢地被喷射出来。这样的事件以前被认为是不可能的。

或许，存在某种方式将高度聚集的§Y$astral_threads$§!羽流导入奇点之中，从而让星界细缝被喷射出来，使这个恒星系的空间重新稳定。

然而，若是不采取进一步行动，我们可以继续从安全距离采集这些宇宙织物。
entries.en:
Some of the particles being released by the black hole in [from.System.GetName] are, in fact, §Y$astral_threads$§!. This means that at some point in time an Astral Scar was pulled into its singularity and is now slowly being ejected. Such an event was previously thought impossible.

There may be a way to eject the scar and restabilize this system's space by directing a highly concentrated stream of §Y$astral_threads$§! into the singularity.

However, taking no further action would allow us to continue harvesting the cosmic fabric from a safe distance.
Inject astral material into the singularity.
Collect the thread from a safe distance.

entries.zh: 将§Y$astral_threads$§!注入奇点立马引起了剧烈的反应，由于黑洞的引力，大量的超维粒子喷涌而出。这些粒子已经聚集成一个悬浮在其引力井中的$astral_rift$。\n\n这个天体异常点之前是如何被吸入奇点，我们仍然不了解，但现在我们至少可以调查一下裂隙的另一边有什么存在。
entries.en: The injection of §Y$astral_threads$§! into the singularity caused an immediate and violent reaction, as a flood of extra-dimensional particles poured forth from the gravitational pull of the black hole. These particles have coalesced into an $astral_rift$ that is now suspended within its gravity well.\n\nHow this celestial anomaly was ever sucked into the singularity in the first place remains unknown, but now we can at least investigate what lies on the other side.

entries.zh: [from.System.GetName]的黑洞将先前被其奇点吸收的$pc_astral_scar$抛射了出来，随之而来的还有大量被束缚的星界物质。\n\n黑洞的引力现在变得正常了。
entries.en: The black hole in [from.System.GetName] has ejected the $pc_astral_scar$ that was temporarily absorbed into its singularity, along with a significant amount of trapped astral material.\n\nThe gravitational forces of the black hole have since normalized.

entries.en: visible in the sky from the planet's southern hemisphere. Rampant speculation exists about its origins, as well as what dangers or opportunities it might present.\n\nAmateur astronomers from across the [owner.GetName] have flocked to the planet to see it for themselves.

entries.en: leads to the center of a clockwork galaxy, where a mechanical god winds a timepiece to maintain balance across infinite worlds.\n\nIn contrast, others say their visions have revealed a black star that holds the key to enlightenment.

entries.zh: 人群之间的割裂在[this.GetName]上日益加剧。殖民者报告的奇怪幻境引发了激烈的辩论，并最终演变为暴力事件。当地领导人呼吁发表一份官方的声明。\n\n尽管可能看起来荒谬，我们被要求为机械神或黑星的存在提供可信说明，作为
entries.en: The schism between the population on [this.GetName] is worsening. The strange visions reported by the colonists have triggered fierce debates that have finally led to outbreaks of violence. Local leaders are calling for an official proclamation.\n\nAs outlandish as it may seem, we are being asked to lend credibility to either the existence of a mechanical god or a black star beyond their
Let them look to the black star.

entries.zh: 无论哪种视景都没有好处。

[this.GetName]上发生了灾难！

人们所经历的相互冲突的视景导致了大规模的动荡。竞相敌对的团体已经拿起了武器，局部的小规模冲突导致了全球范围内的暴力冲突。

这种情况不能继续下去。
entries.en:
Disaster on [this.GetName]!

The contrasting visions experienced by the population have resulted in large-scale unrest. The competing groups have taken up arms, with local skirmishes leading to violent clashes all across the planet.

This can not be allowed to continue.

Severe punishments for anyone caught broaching the forbidden topic have discouraged open conflict.\n\nMany colonists have moved on to new pursuits, but a core group of amateur astronomers continue to enjoy the sheer spectacle of the

entries.zh: 我们检测到§Y[this.GetName]§!地表上的自发爆炸！在没有在轨战舰或可探测到的地表生命的情况下，这些巨大爆炸的产生原因仍然未知。
entries.en: We have detected spontaneous explosions on the surface of §Y[this.GetName]§!. With no orbiting warships or detectable surface life, the cause of these massive blasts remains unknown.

entries.zh: §Y[from.GetName]§!的地表布满了有缺陷的军火，每次爆炸都会在行星上切割出一块块的碎片。\n\n我们对这些武器十分陌生，其本身又是极其易爆的。此外，爆炸产生的图案表明了整个行星上埋藏这一个起爆网络。
entries.en: The surface of §Y[from.GetName]§! is riddled with defective munitions, each carving out chunks of the planet as it detonates.\n\nThe weapons themselves are unfamiliar and extremely volatile. Furthermore, the pattern of the explosive discharges indicates a network of buried launch sites across the planet.

entries.zh: 进一步的分析表明，这颗行星曾经被用作巨大的武器储存库。在静止了数千年之后，个别武器现在开始出现故障，将整个行星变成了一个不稳定的战场。\n\n我们有能力以受控的方式触发所有剩余的弹药。或者，我们可以尝试提取一些武器并在它们爆炸之前将其停用。
entries.en: Further analysis indicates that this planet was once used as an enormous weapons cache. Having sat inactive for thousands of years, individual weapons are now beginning to malfunction, turning the entire planet into an unstable battlefield.\n\nWe have the capacity to trigger all remaining munitions in a controlled manner. Alternatively, we could attempt to extract some of the weapons and deactivate them before they explode.

entries.zh: 试图回收这些古老的炸药。
entries.en: Attempt to recover the ancient explosives.

entries.zh: 在[from.GetName]周围部署了一系列精心设计的炸药之后，我们触发了链式反应，彻底摧毁了这颗行星。
entries.en: After deploying a carefully engineered set of charges around [from.GetName], we triggered a chain reaction that destroyed the planet entirely.

entries.zh: 我们通过理论推导得出，这个裂隙的产生是因为一场极其强大的、能够产生奇点的爆炸，这是由武器储藏库中的某一件武器产生的。
entries.en: We theorize that the opening of this rift was caused by a uniquely powerful singularity-generating explosive stored in one of the many weapon caches.

entries.en: We were able to create an extraction pipeline for the weapons stored within the planet's surface, rendering active munitions inert before preparing them for collection and analysis.\n\nEstablishing a permanent colony on this planet would allow us to take advantage of the remaining cache more efficiently.

entries.zh: 位于[from.GetName]的研究人员在行星上废弃的武器库中发现了一枚受损的奇点生成导弹。这种武器似乎被设计成能够通过暴力方式创建一个引力坍缩，有可能撕裂时空本身。\n\n不幸的是，这件武器已经损坏到无法修复的程度，也超出了我们的复制能力。然而，我们可能能够将其重新用于研究类似的爆炸性武器。
entries.en: Researchers studying [from.GetName] have discovered a damaged singularity-generating missile within the planet's abandoned weapon caches. This weapon was seemingly designed to create a violent gravitational implosion, with the potential to rend a hole in space-time itself.\n\nUnfortunately, this armament is damaged beyond repair and beyond our capabilities to replicate. However, we may be able to repurpose it as part of our research into similar explosive weapons.

entries.zh: 在尝试为[from.GetName]上被废弃的武器建立一个提取管线时，[this.GetName]被一个失灵的爆炸装置摧毁了。船上的所有人都丧生了，包括[leader.GetName]。\n\n船的爆炸进一步触发了武器储藏网络中的一系列不稳定的连锁反应。
entries.en: While attempting to create an extraction pipeline for the abandoned weapons on [from.GetName], [this.GetName] was destroyed by a malfunctioning explosive. All aboard the vessel were lost, including [leader.GetName].\n\nThe ship's explosion further triggered a volatile chain reaction across the network of weapon caches.
