entries.zh: [from.GetName]上的不稳定武器由于自发爆炸引发了一连串的连锁反应，导致该行星完全破裂。\n\n在残骸中，我们发现了大量的§Y$volatile_motes$§!。这种资源一定是存储在地表下的武器的关键组成部分。
entries.en: The spontaneous explosions of unstable weapons on [from.GetName] culminated in a chain reaction that caused the planet to completely break apart.\n\nAmong the debris, we have detected a significant concentration of §Y$volatile_motes$§!. This resource must have formed a key component of the weapons stored beneath the surface.

entries.zh: 这处设施用于处理某个失落文明的储备中留下来的古代武器。
entries.en: This facility processes ancient weapons from caches left by a lost civilization.

entries.zh: 这些实用的研究者负责检查古代武器，对其进行逆向工程，使其适配我们现代化的装备配置。
entries.en: These practical researchers inspect and reverse-engineer ancient weapons to fit our modern specifications.

entries.zh: 专业化的单元，用于拆解和分析古代武器。
entries.en: Specialized units for the disassembly and analysis of ancient weapons.

entries.zh: 这些子个体能够高效地拆解古代武器，使其适配我们现代化的装备配置。
entries.en: These drones efficiently disassemble ancient weapons to fit our modern specifications.

entries.zh: 时空的丝缕蕴含着每个维度的秘密，包括我们自己的维度。这些研究人员不知疲倦地工作，努力解读它们的意义，同时尽量减少悖论。
entries.en: The strands of space-time contain the secrets of every dimension, including our own. These researchers work tirelessly to decipher their significance while minimizing paradoxes.

entries.zh: 时空的丝缕蕴含着每个维度的秘密，包括我们自己的维度。这些子个体不知疲倦地工作，努力解读它们的意义，同时尽量减少悖论。
entries.en: The strands of space-time contain the secrets of every dimension, including our own. These drones are tasked with deciphering their significance while minimizing paradoxes.

entries.zh: 时空的丝缕蕴含着每个维度的秘密，包括我们自己的维度。这些单元不知疲倦地工作，努力解读它们的意义，同时尽量减少悖论。
entries.en: The strands of space-time contain the secrets of every dimension, including our own. These units attempt to decipher their significance while avoiding paradoxes at all costs.

entries.zh: 星界行动界面允许我们使用$ASTRAL_THREADS_ICON$来产生各种全国范围内的效果。我们探索的§S星界裂隙§!越多，我们就能解锁更多行动。有些行动可以随时间重复使用，而其他行动只能使用一次以解锁新的能力或技术。
entries.en: The Astral Actions screen allows us to spend our $ASTRAL_THREADS_ICON$ on various empire-wide effects. The more §SAstral Rifts§! we explore, the more actions we will unlock. Some actions are repeatable over time, while others can be used only once to unlock new abilities or technologies.

entries.zh:
星界裂隙窗口显示当前选择的§S星界裂隙§!的详细信息。在项目进展的每个阶段，你需要根据提出给科学官下达命令，这将导致不同的、有时意想不到的结果。大多数征服星界裂隙的探险都有多条可供选择的路径。

为了揭开某个星界裂隙的秘密，科学官必须取得§S突破§!，以在星界裂隙的每个阶段取得进展。具有相关§S特质和技能水平更高§!的科学官可以更快地抵达下一个阶段，而所选路径的难度评级更高将减慢进展速度。任何长时间调查裂隙的科学官都将积累§S线索§!，这将增加突破的可能性。

在探索§S星界裂隙§!时，科学官被束缚在另一个维度中，直到探险完成才能解除其职务。由于以这种方式被困在时间和空间之外，他们不会因为年老而死亡。
entries.en:
The Astral Rift window shows details of the currently selected §SAstral Rift§!. At each stage of progress, you may be prompted with orders to give our Scientists that will lead to varying, sometimes unexpected results. Most expeditions beyond Astral Rifts have multiple paths to follow.

To unravel the secrets of a Rift, a Scientist must make a §SBreakthrough§! to advance through each of the Rift's stages. Scientists with relevant §STraits and higher Skill§! speed the process of advancing to the next stage, while a higher Difficulty rating of a path choice will slow it. Any Scientist who investigates a Rift for long enough will amass §SClues§! which will make a Breakthrough more likely.

While exploring an §SAstral Rift§!, Scientists are tethered into another dimension and cannot be removed until the exploration is complete. As a consequence of being trapped between time and space in this fashion, they cannot die from old age.

entries.zh: 与[FromFromFrom.GetName]的裂隙探球一同从星界裂隙出现的，是一幅引起了我们注意的异常景象：探球的尾迹中跟随着一个休眠的逃生舱。很快，我们就收到了一个简单的求救信号，并附有实时视频。
entries.en: Emerging from the Astral Rift alongside the [FromFromFrom.GetName]'s Rift Sphere, an unexpected sight catches our attention: a dormant escape pod trailing in the Sphere's wake. Soon, we receive a simple distress signal, accompanied by a live video feed.

entries.zh: 这位快乐的百岁老布洛葛对外星文化，尤其是人类充满热情。她勇敢地穿越了星际裂隙来到这里，任务是：交朋友。
entries.en: A centenarian with a passion for alien cultures, especially Humans, this cheerful Blorg braved an Astral Rift to get here. Their mission: making Friends.

entries.zh: §H这只令人厌恶的外星人站在我们面前，茫然地沉默着，全身上下只有菌毛在像波浪一样有节奏地起伏着。这只生物突然回过神来，挥动触角自我介绍道:§!\n\n啊？怎么？这是哪？抱歉。我叫梅赛德斯·罗梅罗，是布洛葛合众国的探险家和外交官。你听说过人类吗？
entries.en: §HThe repugnant alien stands before us in dazed silence, its only motion that of its pileus, undulating in a wave like rythm. Abruptly regaining composure, with a flourish of tentacles the creature introduces itself: §!\n\nWhat- Whe- Where am I? I am sorry. My name is Mercedes Romero, explorer and diplomat of the Blorg Commmonality. Do you know of the Humans?

entries.zh:
§H这只令人厌恶的外星人站在我们面前，茫然地沉默着，全身上下只有菌毛在像波浪一样有节奏地起伏着。在注意到我们之后，她几乎要猛扑上来，然后又控制住了自己。§!

你们、你们是人类！？§H*尖叫*§!我——我太抱歉了，从我还是一只萌孢的时候就对你们的文化超级感兴趣！

§H这只外星人伸出了一只触手，令人尴尬地尝试模仿握手动作。§!

我叫梅赛德斯·罗梅罗，很高兴见到你们。
entries.en:
§HThe repugnant alien stands before us in dazed silence, its only motion that of its pileus, undulating in a wave like rythm. Upon registering us, it makes a lunging movement before restraining itself.§!

Y- You- You are Humans!? §H*Squeee*§! I- I am sorry, I have been fascinated with your culture ever since I was a little sporeling!

§HThe alien extends a tentacle in an awkward attempt to mimic a handshake.§!

My name is Mercedes Romero and it is my pleasure to meet you.

entries.zh: 我最后的记忆是在心宿二星系。当时我和一群朋友在一起进行舰队行动，突然看到了一束强光。那之后就什么都不记得了。我是坐着逃生舱来的。孤独且无友。
entries.en: My last memory is of the Antares System. I was engaged in a fleet action with a group of Friends when I saw a bright light. After that there is nothing. I arrived here in my escape pod. Alone and Friendless.

entries.zh: 你为什么对人类如此感兴趣？
entries.en: Why are you so fascinated with Humans?

entries.zh: 噢，人类，最美妙的生物。我们布洛葛已经关注了他们几个世纪。其实，我们文化的大部分都是基于对人类生活的观察。色彩！戏剧！友谊！他们教会我们生活远不只是生存，甚至还可以交朋友！这个概念真是绝妙，简直可以说是奇迹！
entries.en: Oh Humans are the most wondrous of creatures. We Blorg have been observing them for centuries. In fact, much of our culture is based on what we have observed of Human life. The color! The drama! The Friendship! They have taught us that life is about more than simple survival. You can also make Friends! What a wonderful concept. What a marvel!
What can you do for us?

entries.zh: 这问题可真不友好，但我有求必应！当然，我有着上百年的驾驶科研船的经验，但我真正醉心的是跨星系关系。把我当成朋友，我可以帮你们交上更多的朋友。拜托了，如果你们感兴趣的话，务必让我代表你们的外交利益！
entries.en: Not a very Friendly question, but if service is required, then I stand ready! Of course, I have centuries of experience captaining research vessels, but my true passion is intergalactic relations. By being your Friend I can help you to make other Friends in the process. Please, if you will have me, let me represent your diplomatic interests!

entries.zh: §Y$NAME_Mercedes$§!作为一名§H领袖§!加入了我们的帝国。
该个体对一个特定直立哺乳类物种的广播和文化进行了上百年的研究，使其在渴望取悦他人方面变得肆无忌惮，或者说是厚颜无耻。
entries.en: Centuries of studying the broadcasts and culture of a certain species of upright mammal has made this individual brazenly eager to please. Some would say, annoyingly so.
